title: useDebouncedValue hook
summary: Package timer logic in a reusable custom hook.
prompt: Write `useDebouncedValue(value, delayMs)`. It returns the latest `value` only after `value` has stopped changing for `delayMs` milliseconds. Every change restarts the timer. `SearchPreview` uses it to show "Searching for: …".
hints: In an effect on `[value, delayMs]`, start a `setTimeout` and return `() => clearTimeout(id)`. The cleanup is what restarts the timer.
